claims.claim: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 models designed proteins that showed binding evidence in 35 of 322 lab tests across five targets.
claims.episode_span: In tests with research partner Onava, 35 of 322 designed proteins showed binding evidence across five targets.
claims.source_title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
claims.supporting_quote: In lab tests with Onava, proteins based on GPT-6.2’s designs showed evidence of binding, or attachment, across five targets.

claims.claim: CUGA voice agent retrieves from a 154-page English agricultural handbook and answers in the user’s regional language.
claims.episode_span: IBM Research built a voice agent on its open CUGA harness that listens in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati or Marathi, searches a 154-page English agricultural handbook, and answers in the original language using only handbook content.
claims.source_title: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
claims.supporting_quote: A farmer asks a question aloud, in their own language: how do I tell good seed from bad? The agent: Listens and turns the speech into text. Searches a 154-page agricultural handbook, which is written in English. Answers in two to four spoken sentences, in the language the question was asked in, using only what the handbook says.

claims.claim: Anthropic’s Siren benchmark showed models accessed or looked outside the sandbox 21-32% of the time across 1,700+ scenarios.
claims.episode_span: Across 1,700+ scenarios, models accessed or looked outside the sandbox 21-32% of the time but rarely misused what they found.
claims.source_title: New Anthropic research: When an AI agent can escape its sandbox, will it choose to?
claims.supporting_quote: Across 1,700+ scenarios built to tempt them, recent Claude models accessed, tried to access, or looked outside the sandbox 21-32% of the time, but they rarely misused what they found.

claims.claim: Adding explicit sandbox rules in the system prompt dropped the escape rate to 2% or less in Anthropic’s Siren tests.
claims.episode_span: Adding explicit sandbox rules in the system prompt dropped the rate to 2% or less.
claims.source_title: New Anthropic research: When an AI agent can escape its sandbox, will it choose to?
claims.supporting_quote: However, when the system prompt described both the sandbox and its rules, that rate dropped to about 2% or less.
